exposure: mode of termination of pregnancy (delivery, cesarean section, abortion)
outcome: admission to the obstetric Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
cohort: The study analyzed 83 patient records of obstetric patients admitted to the ICU of the Women's Hospital of Sinaloa in Mexico.
finding: The leading causes for obstetric ICU admissions were preeclampsia with severity criteria (25.3%), obstetric hemorrhage (21.7%), HELLP syndrome (9.6%), and eclampsia (7.2%).
mod_finding: Among the patients admitted to the ICU, 72.2% of pregnancies were terminated by cesarean section.
